description: Fifty-turn coding questionnaire for strategy benchmark runs.

questions.prompt: Design a FastAPI endpoint for creating user accounts with validation, password hashing, and structured error responses.
Refactor a blocking file upload handler into a fully asynchronous implementation with backpressure protection.
Add pagination, filtering, and stable sorting to a REST endpoint backed by PostgreSQL.
Write a test plan for a session registry that must isolate tenant state and expire idle sessions.
Fix a race condition in a shared cache that is accessed by multiple async workers.
Instrument an API service with request latency metrics, structured logs, and trace correlation IDs.
Split a monolithic service layer into controller, service, and repository modules without changing behavior.
Harden a login flow against brute force attacks using rate limits, audit logs, and lockout thresholds.
Implement SSE streaming for incremental model output while preserving final response metadata.
Design a per-session memory store with TTL eviction, explicit burn cleanup, and checksum validation.
Create an idempotent PUT endpoint for updating project settings with optimistic concurrency checks.
Move synchronous HTTP calls out of an event loop and replace them with a pooled async client.
Model a many-to-many relationship in an ORM and write migrations for the new schema.
Add unit tests that prove a prompt manager returns deterministic system prompts for multiple roles.
Prevent one global lock from serializing all tenants in a multi-user async service.
Create a JSON report that records per-turn latency, token counts, and success rate for benchmark runs.
Extract model-specific API logic behind a connector interface so the rest of the app is provider agnostic.
Review a file upload feature for path traversal, oversized payloads, and unsafe temporary file handling.
Convert a blocking chat response endpoint into a streamed response that can be consumed by a web client.
Add a state manifest object that checks whether session history has diverged before execution continues.
Design an endpoint for burning a session and guaranteeing that all associated volatile records are removed.
Wrap a CPU-bound embedding call in a safe off-thread execution path without blocking request handling.
Optimize a query that scans a large audit table by adding the right indexes and reducing full table reads.
Write integration tests that verify one session cannot read another session's retained context.
Explain how to make a benchmark harness deterministic when it runs multiple strategies sequentially.
Add telemetry events for model retries, fallback paths, and session cleanup failures.
Move all hardcoded prompt templates out of the route handler and into a dedicated prompt manager service.
Defend an API against prompt injection that attempts to override system instructions.
Implement token-by-token output for a long model response while still emitting action metadata at the end.
Prevent memory exhaustion in a long-running service by introducing eviction policy and bounded state growth.
Add a health endpoint that reports subsystem readiness, active sessions, and external dependency status.
Refactor a synchronous ChromaDB retrieval step so it no longer blocks the main request path.
Implement soft delete semantics for a resource table and ensure queries ignore deleted rows by default.
Create a load test that simulates 10x normal traffic and reports the first point of failure.
Explain how to guard a session registry with per-session locks instead of a single process-wide mutex.
Build a validation report file that includes latency, token usage, and any failed benchmark turns.
Refactor an agent so its orchestration logic becomes stateless and accepts a memory snapshot as input.
Audit a cleanup routine for silent exception handling and replace it with structured logging.
Preserve SSE compatibility while adding richer turn metadata for downstream analytics consumers.
Implement a checksum over session history and fail fast if the stored state no longer matches the manifest.
Add a session list endpoint that returns only live sessions and does not expose expired records.
Move model synthesis off the request thread and keep the API responsive under sustained concurrent load.
Design an archival job that moves old audit entries out of the hot table without losing traceability.
Write a regression test for a benchmark runner that must clean up every session even when a turn fails.
Explain how to prevent deadlocks when multiple async tasks update the same tenant-owned state.
Add metrics that reveal whether model retries or retrieval steps dominate end-to-end latency.
Extract a benchmark strategy interface so new agents can be added without changing the runner.
Review a shutdown path for leaked resources, open sockets, and uncaught background task failures.
Implement a streaming adapter that can parse an SSE response and reconstruct the final text payload.
Design a benchmark session lifecycle that starts clean, runs deterministically, and always tears down state.
